# Major new features

## OIDC back-channel logout - #2740

Warpgate now accepts OpenID Connect Back-Channel Logout requests at `/@warpgate/api/sso/providers/<name>/backchannel-logout`. When the identity provider signs a user out, it ends their Warpgate sessions on every cluster node. The new `disable_local_logout` provider option hides Warpgate's own "log out" button when the provider supports single logout.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/warp-tech/warpgate/compare/v0.30.0-beta.2...v0.30.0-be

# Major new features

## Vault-signed SSH certificates for target authentication - #2734

SSH targets can now authenticate with a short-lived OpenSSH certificate signed per connection by a Vault / OpenBao secret backend.
